title: QuPath-MCP: a state-aware interface for reproducible AI-agent workflows in digital pathology
description:
QuPath-MCP is a QuPath extension that embeds a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, letting AI agents inspect, execute, verify and reproduce digital-pathology workflows in QuPath. It exposes 34 typed tools spanning image/project state, viewer perception, annotation, detection and measurement, script execution and workflow provenance. Every tool declares a machine-readable side-effect hint (read-only, write or destructive), destructive capabilities are individually gated, and a provenance layer records each executed step so a saved workflow can be replayed deterministically with no model in the loop.

This archive contains the full QuPath fork in which the extension is bundled (module qupath-extension-mcp), derived from QuPath (Bankhead et al., 2017).
